name: feral-special-victoire-attempt-01b
prompt:
Produce ONE sparse PORTRAIT native RGBA sprite sheet1024x1536: exactly TWO COLUMNS×FOUR ROWS, EIGHT isolated full-body drawings. Use attached images ONLY for Feral's identity/anatomy/style, not their backgrounds. New articulated poses, never mirror or rig. Accurate Feral: lean sinewy ochre-spotted skin, black dreads, ivory bone skull mask and exposed red mandibles, dark segmented loincloth, asymmetrical bone hip ornaments, bronze bracers, wrapped ankles and clawed bare toes. No shoulder cannon.

Every invisible cell512×384. Body about180px tall, never larger than210px, with at least80px ALPHA ZERO space above and below. Whole drawing including gear/any neutral stand-in below380px wide and inside its own cell. Huge empty transparent gutters; no touching/cropped silhouettes. LEFT COLUMN: Feral faces RIGHT, front/right-side view. RIGHT COLUMN: independently drawn Feral faces LEFT, back/left-side view; asymmetric gear stays on the same anatomical limbs. Same stage on each row. Same fixed body scale everywhere.

BACKGROUND MUST BE ALPHA0 outside the exact figure/gear silhouettes: NO floor plane, no cast shadow, no aura, no ambient glow, no gradient, no fog, smoke or painted backdrop. Crisp narrow edges, no blur. No text, numbers, labels, borders or grid.

GEAR AND SCOPE: Quiet source victory, not celebration. A separable spear, LEFT handheld bolt launcher only when being checked. No crowd, no anatomical trophy, no shoulder cannon. Props are the same existing gear, never duplicate a spear.

ROW1: Neutral standing body reference with hands empty and two spear halves lying close beside the feet, completely inside the cell. This neutral reference is outside the clip and must show complete standing anatomy for a fixed body-height review.
ROW2: Feral joins the spear halves into one intact weapon held low at his side, no third spare spear.
ROW3: He lowers the spear and inspects the left-hand bolt launcher ammunition housing with the free hand; no new bolts magically appear.
ROW4: He keeps the weapons lowered and turns head and upper torso slightly to listen beyond the duel space, quiet alert stance rather than a salute.
